name: Mercury
blurb: MESSENGER gravity (JGMESS_160A). A topography grid can be added with Load planet.

grids.label: Free-air gravity
grids.note: JGMESS_160A (Konopliv et al. 2020) at 2440 km, degrees 2–55 with a taper above 35. The C20 flattening term is removed. MESSENGER flew low over the north, so the southern hemisphere is much blurrier.

shadeNote: Relief shading from a normal map that Celestia derived from the USGS MESSENGER DEM.

images.label: Visible colour
images.note: Celestia texture (FarGetaNik) from the USGS MESSENGER colour map, gaps filled with the greyscale mosaic. Brightness stretched for display.

sites.name: MESSENGER impact
sites.note: Ended its mission by hitting the surface at 3.9 km/s, making a crater about 16 m wide.

sources: Konopliv et al. (2020), JGMESS_160A gravity, Icarus 335 (copy in tudat-resources)
Celestia Content: Mercury texture and normal map
